description_en: Uses paging to perform a paged query on AI model invoke records that meet specified conditions
description_zh: 分页查询指定条件下的AI模型调用记录
name: DescribeAICallDetails

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query, inclusive. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 format with a time zone, accurate to seconds. The default value is 00:00:00 (UTC+8) of the current day. The time cannot be earlier than three calendar months before the current time, and the query time range cannot exceed 30 days
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，包含该时刻。使用带时区的 ISO 8601 格式，精确到秒；默认北京时间当日零点。不得早于当前时间向前推算 3 个自然月，查询区间不超过 30 天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query, exclusive. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard with a time zone, accurate to seconds. The default value is the current time. The time must be later than StartTime and cannot be later than the current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，不包含该时刻。使用带时区的 ISO 8601 格式，精确到秒；默认当前时间。应晚于 StartTime 且不晚于当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The model invocation request ID for exact match. This ID is different from the RequestId of the current API operation. If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, no filtering is performed. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain control characters or vertical bars. This condition is combined with other filter conditions by using the AND operator
parameters.help_zh: 模型调用请求 ID，精确匹配；与本次 OpenAPI 的 RequestId 不同。不传或空白不筛选。最多128字符，不能包含控制字符或竖线。与其他筛选条件取交集
parameters.name: search_request_id

parameters.help_en: The model ID requested during the invocation for exact match. Fuzzy match is not supported. This ID may be different from the actual executed model Model returned in the response. If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, no filtering is performed. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain control characters or vertical bars
parameters.help_zh: 调用时请求的模型 ID，精确匹配，不支持模糊匹配；与返回的实际执行模型 Model 可能不同。不传或空白不筛选。最多128字符，不能包含控制字符或竖线
parameters.name: model_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1. The product of PageNumber and PageSize cannot exceed 1,000,000
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从1开始，默认1。PageNumber与PageSize的乘积不得超过1000000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，范围1至50，默认10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The business edition. Valid values: ENTERPRISE or 1 for Enterprise Edition, and BUSINESS or 20 for Business Edition. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is Enterprise Edition
parameters.help_zh: 业务版本。ENTERPRISE或1表示企业版，BUSINESS或20表示商业版；不传默认企业版
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en: The list of user IDs. You can specify up to 50 user IDs. If this parameter is not specified or an empty array is passed, no filtering is performed. The user IDs in the list are combined by using the OR operator, and the list is combined with other filter conditions by using the AND operator
parameters.help_zh: 用户 ID 列表，最多50项。不传或空数组不筛选。列表内为或关系，与其他筛选条件为且关系
parameters.name: wy_ids

parameters.help_en: The region of the AI gateway logs. Valid values: cn-shanghai (Shanghai), cn-hongkong (Hong Kong), ap-southeast-1 (Singapore), and us-east-1 (US East). The value cn-hangzhou is also supported and routed to cn-shanghai in the production environment. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is Shanghai for the China site and Singapore for the International site
parameters.help_zh: AI网关日志地域。支持cn-shanghai（上海）、cn-hongkong（香港）、ap-southeast-1（新加坡）、us-east-1（美国东部）；兼容cn-hangzhou，线上查询路由等同cn-shanghai。不传时国内站默认上海，国际站默认新加坡
parameters.name: gateway_region

CallDetails.description_en: The list of AI invocation details on the current page. If no records are found, an empty array is returned
CallDetails.description_zh: 当前页的AI调用明细列表，无记录时为空数组

items.description_en: The details of a single AI model invocation
items.description_zh: 单条AI模型调用的明细信息

AgentType.description_en: The product or agent type associated with the invocation, which retains the original value from the deduction record. If no match is found or the query fails, this parameter is not returned
AgentType.description_zh: 调用关联的产品或Agent类型，沿用抵扣记录中的原始值。未匹配或查询失败时不返回

CallStatus.description_en: The invocation status. Valid values: SUCCESS for successful invocations (HTTP 2xx), RATE_LIMITED for throttled invocations (HTTP 429), TIMEOUT for timed-out invocations (HTTP 504), and FAILED for other failure statuses
CallStatus.description_zh: 调用状态。SUCCESS表示成功（HTTP 2xx），RATE_LIMITED表示限流（429），TIMEOUT表示超时（504），FAILED表示其他失败状态

CallTime.description_en: The time of the model invocation log, in the ISO 8601 standard and UTC+08:00 time zone
CallTime.description_zh: 模型调用日志时间，ISO 8601格式，UTC+08:00

FirstTokenLatencyMs.description_en: The latency of the first token, in milliseconds. If the invocation fails or no first token data is available, this parameter is empty
FirstTokenLatencyMs.description_zh: 首Token时延，单位毫秒。调用失败或无首Token数据时为空

GatewayRegion.description_en: The actual data region of the invocation log
GatewayRegion.description_zh: 本条调用日志的实际数据地域

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code returned by the AI gateway

InputToken.description_en: The number of original input tokens. If no valid data is available, this parameter is empty
InputToken.description_zh: 原始输入Token数量；无有效数据时为空

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the product associated with the model invoke
InstanceId.description_zh: 模型调用关联的产品实例ID

Model.description_en: The ID of the actually invoked model. If the actual model is missing, the requested model is used as a fallback
Model.description_zh: 实际调用的模型ID；实际模型缺失时回退为请求模型

Points.description_en: The actual deducted points that are matched, returned as a decimal string. A true zero value is returned as 0. If no match is found or the query fails, this parameter is not returned. Do not treat a missing value as zero
Points.description_zh: 已匹配的实际抵扣积分，以十进制字符串返回。真实零值返回0；未匹配或查询失败时不返回，不能将缺失值视为零

PointsBreakdown.description_en: The point breakdown of the matched deduction record for the current invocation, which comes from the same record as Points. If no valid details are available, this object is not returned. If the object exists, all five point items are returned. The sum of the five items equals Points, and a true zero value is returned as the string 0
PointsBreakdown.description_zh: 本条调用已匹配抵扣记录的积分构成，与Points来自同一条记录。缺少有效明细时不返回此对象；对象存在时完整返回五项积分，五项之和等于Points，真实零值返回字符串0

ExplicitCacheCreation.description_en: The explicit cache creation points, in points, represented as a decimal string. A true zero value is 0
ExplicitCacheCreation.description_zh: 显式缓存创建积分，单位为积分，使用十进制字符串表示；真实零值为0

ExplicitCacheHit.description_en: The explicit cache hit points, in points, represented as a decimal string. A true zero value is 0
ExplicitCacheHit.description_zh: 显式缓存命中积分，单位为积分，使用十进制字符串表示；真实零值为0

ImplicitCacheHit.description_en: The implicit cache hit points, in points, represented as a decimal string. A true zero value is 0
ImplicitCacheHit.description_zh: 隐式缓存命中积分，单位为积分，使用十进制字符串表示；真实零值为0

NormalInput.description_en: The normal input points, in points, represented as a decimal string. A true zero value is 0
NormalInput.description_zh: 普通输入积分，单位为积分，使用十进制字符串表示；真实零值为0

Output.description_en: The output points, in points, represented as a decimal string. A true zero value is 0
Output.description_zh: 输出积分，单位为积分，使用十进制字符串表示；真实零值为0

RequestId.description_en: The request ID of the AI gateway invocation, which is different from the request ID of the outer API operation
RequestId.description_zh: 本条AI网关调用的请求ID，与外层OpenAPI请求ID不同

WyId.description_en: The ID of the user who initiated the model invocation. If no valid data is available, this parameter is empty
WyId.description_zh: 发起模型调用的用户ID。无有效数据时为空

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

QueryEndTime.description_en: The actual end time of the query, in the ISO 8601 standard and UTC+08:00 time zone. Reuse this value when you turn pages
QueryEndTime.description_zh: 实际查询结束时间，ISO 8601格式，UTC+08:00。翻页时复用此值

QueryStartTime.description_en: The actual start time of the query, in the ISO 8601 standard and UTC+08:00 time zone. Reuse this value when you turn pages
QueryStartTime.description_zh: 实际查询开始时间，ISO 8601格式，UTC+08:00。翻页时复用此值

RequestId.description_en: The request ID of the current API operation, which is used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次OpenAPI调用的请求ID，用于定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of invocation records that meet the query conditions, including records that do not match any deducted points
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的调用记录总数，包含未匹配到抵扣积分的记录
